canonical_name: Assets Not Prioritized Based on Criticality and Impact
description: Assets are not prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and mission impact.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of asset classification schemes, missing criticality ratings, lack of business impact assessments, or gaps in asset prioritization frameworks. Organizations should implement risk-based prioritization that considers data sensitivity, business criticality, regulatory requirements, and operational dependencies.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
